issues.legal_issue: A dispute over whether an agreement has been cancelled or may lawfully be cancelled falls within an arbitration clause covering disputes arising out of or in connection with the agreement.
An action under Section 31 of the Specific Relief Act for cancellation of an instrument is not an action in rem.
A court must refer a dispute to arbitration under Section 8 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act when the dispute is covered by a valid arbitration clause.
